mainEntity.name: Is my Aadhaar uploaded to this site?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your browser reads and masks your document locally. Software assets and optional Cloudflare Web Analytics requests use the network, but they do not carry your document. You can inspect requests in DevTools → Network and read the source on GitHub.

mainEntity.name: What does masked or redacted Aadhaar mean?

acceptedAnswer.text: Masked Aadhaar hides the first 8 digits of the 12-digit number, leaving the last 4 visible. DocRedact creates a locally redacted copy of a file you already have, not an official UIDAI-issued download. Check which fields your recipient requires before sharing.

Detected Aadhaar numbers have their first 8 digits selected. Detected PAN numbers, passport MRZ regions, probable UIDAI QR codes and faces are also selected by default. Tinted selections show the exported mask boundaries. Uncheck unwanted detections and use manual mode to cover missed content. Other QR codes are masked only if you select them.

mainEntity.name: Can I use this on my phone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Take a photo, choose an existing file, or try the synthetic sample. Processing runs in your mobile browser. Use a clear JPG or PNG photo and review the result before downloading.

mainEntity.name: What file types and limits apply?

acceptedAnswer.text: JPG, PNG, WebP and PDF up to 20 MB, with up to 10 PDF pages. There is also a 40-million-pixel budget per page and an 80-million-pixel budget for the document; PDF budgets apply after rasterization. Large files may need resizing or splitting. Password-protected PDFs must first be saved as an unprotected copy on your device.

mainEntity.name: Can it download masked Aadhaar without OTP?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. DocRedact does not retrieve Aadhaar or bypass UIDAI authentication. It masks a document you already have. For an official masked Aadhaar download, use the UIDAI myAadhaar portal and follow its requirements.

mainEntity.name: Does it access the UIDAI database or decode QR codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: It does not access the UIDAI database. QR codes are decoded locally to help classify them, and detected faces are located locally without identifying the person. QR contents, OCR text and document pixels are not sent to a server. QR codes can contain personal information, so review them as well as the printed number.

mainEntity.name: Can the masked content be recovered from the output?

acceptedAnswer.text: The export paints solid rectangles onto page images and creates a new image-only PDF. It does not retain the original text layer or removable mask shapes. This protects the regions actually covered, not content the detector missed. Open the downloaded file and verify every page before sharing. File size varies and text search is unavailable.
The consumer tool is free and open source. A browser-side integration for businesses is planned, but is not available yet. The API waitlist is for updates and discussions about that future offering.
